name: Mastery Talisman: Surging Relay
description: When the battle begins: Attach Mastery Talisman: Surging Relay to your active character (the attached character spends 1 fewer Elemental Die for their next Skill. Upon triggering this effect, attach this effect to your next character and create a Efficient Switch). Then, discard this card.
